usedFor: viaSocket Table holds records and viaSocket utilities runs other workflows, so “New Row Created” can run “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Row Created” in viaSocket Table, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new row starts another workflow, so one table entry can drive a longer chain of steps.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires the child flow's id, so set it before choosing a trigger.
